propositions: ExpressionError (execute-time wiring faults: unset input, missing step output, loop var out of scope, missing secret/env, unresolvable ${{ }}) currently maps to llm_unavailable, which misclassifies a caller/state fault as a provider outage

The error_code_for function must classify ExpressionError as expression_unresolved via an explicit error_code attribute on ExpressionError so branch 5 (explicit error_code) fires before branch 6 (LLMError fallback)
A genuine execute-time LLM outage (raised as LLMUnavailableError) must still return llm_unavailable to preserve outage signaling
expression_unresolved must be added to KNOWN_ERROR_CODES and the error taxonomy contract test
Execute-surface tests must verify ExpressionError returns expression_unresolved and genuine LLM unavailability returns llm_unavailable
